zh: 修复模型文案、字体与构建资源路由缺少同源栅栏的问题：这三个入口与其余私有路由共用同一道校验，非本机页面不能再借它们探测用户自置的字体。
en: Fix the model copy, font and built-asset routes missing the same-origin fence every other private route carries: all three now pass the same check, so a page outside this machine can no longer probe the fonts a reader dropped in.
